data.desc: MIRA Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: MIRA) is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company developing novel oral therapies designed to address significant unmet medical needs in pain and metabolic disorders. The Company is building a differentiated pain therapeutics franchise alongside an oral obesity program. Its lead candidate, Ketamir-2, is being developed for neuropathic pain, initially targeting chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy (CIPN). Ketamir-2 has successfully completed Phase 1 clinical testing and is advancing toward Phase 2a under an active IND. MIRA's pipeline also includes MIRA-55, an investigational oral therapy for inflammatory pain, and SKNY-1, an investigational oral therapy for obesity. Following scientific review, the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration has determined that all three candidates are not classified as controlled substances.
